description: [Company & tax] Verify an EU trader's EORI number before shipping, invoicing or filing a customs declaration. Use when customs paperwork or a shipment needs a confirmed EU EORI. Price: $0.01 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/eori-check

eori.description: One EORI number, or up to 10 separated by commas (e.g. DE123456789012345, IE6388047V)

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: check_eori
title: EU EORI Number Check ($0.01)
